title: Second order splitting dynamics for stochastic monotone inclusions with closed loop distribution
summary: In this paper, we investigate the problem of finding a zero of the sum of a maximal monotone operator $A$ and a cocoercive operator $\Bm$ in a Hilbert space. This formulation naturally captures stochastic optimization problems with decision-dependent distributions, often referred to as performative prediction. We propose and analyze continuous-time second-order dynamics governed by a distributionally evaluated forward-backward splitting operator.
